review_description: O'Briens Townsville have been reliably helpful, informative, responsive and thorough throughout the quoting and advisory process, as well as the installation, notwithstanding that the last few months have been extremely busy for them (& the industry generally, due to the increased govt support). I did a lot of detailed consideration due to the specifics of my house & roof etc, and waiting for the increased govt support, and Chris & team, were generally responsive, including seeking answers from suppliers etc when requested. This included me upgrading my battery from 2 to 3 modules after initially accepting the quote, which involved challenges for supply at that time of very high demand.They have a very strong warranty on their work (25 years on work, 10 years on components), although given the rapid development of the industry and technology, it's hard to know how realistically useful that will be in 24 years!They undertook all the grid connection arrangements after the install, gave me instruction on using the interface, provided a line diagram as requested, and stepped me through how the whole thing is connected, what switches control what, etc.Importantly, their admin staff were reliably helpful and responsive (and polite) throughout the process.I deliberately "over-purchased", due to SolarQuotes advice plus the current pricing and the prospect of getting an electric vehicle in the future, but this was not due to over-selling by the supplier,

Mark made contact with me very promptly and visited my home to discuss my particular requirements. One important issue was replacement of the meter box. A good solution was proposed and was completed as part of the installation. The installation was done very quickly after our agreement was reached and was completed with little disruption to us. Tyler, the electrician, just worked efficiently and let us know what was going on. On completion, he showed us how the apps worked and how to monitor the system. The office arranged everything in terms of the paperwork, including photos of the installation, and connection to the grid. Although it is early days, the system seems to be working really well. Considering the whole process, I am very happy with the outcome and would certainly recommend O'Brien Electrical & Solar.

Obrien Electrical and Solar Townsville did exactly what they said they would do from my initial contact / Quote.They went the extra mile with my Solar install and other work I needed done, nothing was too hard and they accommodated our needs every time.  All the trade staff were professional and respectful of my property, they arrived on site each day when they said they would, never left the place untidy, cleaned up as they went and did a check after each day.  My installation was brought forward by a week too!  I have an appointment tomorrow with the construction manager who will go over all the details of the system and help with my grid connection.  I would recommend this company to my friends and family members.
We were impressed with O'Brien and their reps.They are not the cheapest, but we were more than happy with our dealings with them.

Sales rep was great to begin with and throughout the installation process. I felt like once the job was completed the rep was a little slow to respond and has been since.Job was comleted satisfactorily and trades were polite and left the place tidy however showed up late all days and was completed over 3 days and not finished until late Saturday evening.No commissioning tests were carried out.No instructions for use of the App were communicated.

My installation included removal of a small existing system over 12 years ago. The installation team removed all old components efficiently without any issues. Team members were punctual for the commencement of work on both days of the job, polite, respectful and tidy.The installation of the quoted equipment (panels/inverter/battery) was completed by the second day and the system made operational on that day. The system App was connected and explained before the team departed same day. Photos of the job were provided.

This review is my honest and genuine belief about the backup and service level from O’Brien Electrical and Solar in Underwood, BrisbaneSolar system 43 x 415w panels, 43 x optimisers, 2 x Solaredge 8.25kw energy hub inverter’s, 17.8Kw, Meter box replacement (not switchboard).Systems total cost.  Just over $27KI had Solar Quotes 3 recommendations for solar and ended up going with Apollo solar.The main reason I want with them is that the person that quoted the job seemed very knowledgeable and the fact that their warrantee stated 25 years install warranty and guaranteed backup service. And that their warranty stated that if they cannot resolve a fault, they will remove the system and provide a full refund of all payments.Original quote for 38 panels and 6.6kw inverters was $19,9505 Extra panels and upgrade of inverters was about 7k.At no time was a low or non-complying roof mentioned or discussed (the person quoting the job and I walked on the roof).About 1/2 way through the install, they changed to O’Brien solar.They arrived for the install and did not have the gear specified for the job.They arrived back a few weeks later and installed the solar but using the standard horizontal support rail setup(panel in portrait) rather than the vertical (panels in landscape)that was agreed on and was shown on the quote. There does not seem to be adequate communication between the quoting dept and the installers.The tile brackets were 100mm set back but my tile have 125 overlap, so when installed the tiles could not go back to their original location.The installer told me of this and I specifically asked, twice, if a longer bracket was available and the answer was NO these are the standard (part no ER-1-01).(I have since seen on the Clenergy website that a bracket with 123mm ER-1-51, 170mm ER-1-61 and another with 190mm run was available part no ER-1-71 and also another companies brackets with 145mm offset.).Shortly we had rain and the roof leaked in numerous locations on the tile roof.I was very much surprised and disappointed by the follow up service.They came and sealed the roof by plastering the area with Sikaflex and shortly after we had another storm which leaked in the master bedroom to the stage the ceiling cracked open and the water was running through the ceiling fan. The original area also had minor leaks but not to the stage they dripped through the ceiling.They came and “repaired” that leak with more silastic but it is still leaking.Through research I have recently found that repairs of this type are temporary only due to the material breaking down and tile movement loosening the bond (5 years max so lucky I have a 25 year warranty so they can redo it 5 more times).The storms that caused the leaks were standard SEQ thunder storms but not severe weather events.I again called them and emailed them and phoned them many times and had numerous promises from various O’Brien offices but no-one ever came out and nothing was fixed.On 18th April 2024 O’Brien Electrical and Solar Underwood (or their engineer representative) Stated in email that they would engage a professional roofer to inspect and advise on the leaks but that never happened and they have been evasive since.I have had an email from the CEO but cannot discuss it due to “without prejudice” being at the top.I sent O’Brien Electrical and Solar as well as Solar Quotes multiple emails in the last week (concluding 20/03/2025) including calculations of roof pitch(from span and rise) and the readings I took with a digital protractor (and spirit level) and then the inclinometer (angle gauge) as well as 5 solar panels not producing any power.I have repeatedly asked them to rectify this and the engineer response was I will get right on it, but nothing has changed.For this result I could have gone with 5Kw inverters and 6.6kw systems for exactly the same result but saving of between $ 7k to 11k.At The moment I have 3 panels (probably on the most unshaded part of the roof) with no output at all that I have contacted them about and I have had no response whatsoever from them.These are all my honest and genuine beliefs and I will let the reader to draw their own conclusions with regard to this company’s backup service or lack thereof.Furthermore any and all communications from O’Brien Electrical and Solar regarding this review should be sent though the Solar Quotes website as I feel transparency is required and any personal emails with “Without Prejudice” will be automatically archived without being read.

I was very impressed with the salesperson  Mark Chandler. He was very friendly, knowledgable and did not pressure me in any way for the deal. The company provided immediate emailed documents and information on the system I chose. The booked installation proceeded on the date I was advised and the team arrived on time and worked hard and fast on a very hot summer day in Brisbane. The cyclone arrived a week later and there were no issues with the system or roof structure so far.I would recommend this company.

Mark was great in running through the ins and outs of solar system installation, for a complete newbie like me. He inspired confidence with his knowledge. It didnt feel like he was pushing for a sale. Tyler and his installation seem to have done a great job. System's working well at the moment. Time will tell. So far post installation service has been great. Thank you very much team at O'Briens. Best regards. Robbie T

The sales and quoting by the O'Brien representative was informative  and the technical detail explanations  was easily understood.The  installation took some 5 days plus over a  three-four week period due to inclement weather. Rain and wind and flooding events .The grid connection was organised though them.We also took the opportunity to install a 15 amp outlet connection for a  generator.Overall no complaints .

Sales process was very good.Installers  - very good.Customer service - started well and then went a bit downhill. We were having electrical work done at the same time, and from the sales process was always told it was 1.5 days. Installers arrived, looked at the job and stated they couldn't finish in a day. The office had only allocated 1 day, so the install was started on a Thursday and completed on the following Tuesday.

Chris the director of the company didn’t come across as a pushy salesman. Didn’t try to oversell to me and the quote was by far the easiest to understand from everyone else.His suggestions and knowledge he provided to the job really outshined the other companies that came out and quoted.Everything is working as to how he proposed it would be. I haven’t paid an electricity bill months after the installation.From dealing with the office staff to the tradesmen everything has been professional by them.Even after the installation when I’ve had a question, it’s been dealt with by the office staff fuss free and within the hour.I can’t express how highly I recommend them, a company that truly values its customers.Regards,Tom.

95% of the installation/service was great.We however had/have two problems* Admin people were overzealous in demanding full payment before installation - a $500 deposit was negotiated. The installation itself was very professional - even got the fuse box back up to spec.* The problems/issue came after - Charged full payment (deposit not deducted),and took three (3) weeks - including many calls and emails to get $500 deposit back, including invoking Govt 'watchdog'.

Chris focussed on the best system for me based on my needs and situation. The quote was very competitive considering my request for only the best quality equipment was to be used. Damien’s installation team on the day were outstanding - from completing quality trade work to supporting their trainee over the course of the day. I was impressed with their attention to safety for all the team working on the day. Very happy with O’Brien Solar & Electrical across all aspects of the process. Thankyou
Excellent salesman explained benefits and potential pitfalls.Excellent installation team were prompt and very efficient and responsive to my queries.Everything is working perfectly.
I would highly recommend O’Brien solar. Very friendly  and knowledgeable staff, quality products, neat and tidy installation and a system that is performing above stated performance.
Very good service , fast and efficient.Polite and informative service

Had a 10.5kW Enphase solar system installed by O'brien Solar in Brisbane. My research beforehand had me choosing between solar edge and enphase due to my shading issues. During the initial visit, the two sales/installers were very thorough in discussing how each option worked and what was worth doing or not. They didn't talk down to me and were pretty open about what the system performance would be.In the end, it was between them and another company; O'brien matched the quote so I went with them because I preferred the vibe of the installers I spoke to (and less pushy).Installation was quick and painless and the guys ran me through how everything worked on the day with the monitoring and apps running the same afternoon.
Punctual; met the dates they said they would arrive. Kept me informed of issues. Fixed problem of paint spilled on driveway without any hassles.Satisfied with performance of system.
Great process from start to finish. Admin process was smooth and easy as well. System seems to be working well!
Everything went well from beginning to installation. We had the solar for only a day so really early to comment about the system.
Outstanding service from the on site quoting to the final installation and handover.Very good communication throughout the process and efficient workers.Whole process was seamless
We were very happy with the service from the first inspection, the detail included in the quote, the timely delivery and the finished product.
They put a drone up to work out the quote, with good technical explanations.Polite and riendly installers.

Sales person was knowledgeable (Electrician) and previously was installing the systems prior to starting in sales. As mentioned before did not know all the answers to my questions but made an effort to find out.It was good to see these days the electrical and solar panel installers taking pride in their work.  They were polite, punctual and the work was completed on time.Had some issues with the performance of the system but on wiring changes we seem to have resolved this.Customer service was fair but could improve. Still waiting for some documentation and yes they did organise the grid connection.
Ergon Energy are yet to contact me to install digital meter

The response from Rhyme at O'Brien Solar was fast, he was knowledgeable, gave good advice and a competitive quote.  Once I chose to proceed, they were able to slot me in for installation quickly and the panels and inverter were online and operating quickly.  Very happy with the install and products that were supplied.Only a minor gripe, but the contact came from O'Brien, iMAgroup, and various other related companies managing the appointment and invoicing.  That didn't inspire confidence but Rhyme was the main contact from sales right through installation and everything was working fine.  He had explained that they were previously known as Apollo Solar and were now part of O'Brien.

Andrei and Mark were helpful, personable and informative. Their installation team were respectful, tidy, even taking away the old Foxtel dish. They helped set up the app and checked in afterwards to ensure everything was working correctly. Fantastic people to deal with. Highly recommend them.

The sales and quoting process was very good. Plenty of information and were able to answer our questions.Andrei organised for the chap in charge of installing our unit to come out before hand to discuss with us where the cabling was going etc.this was very helpful,the installation was on time. Great guys to have around and kept us in touch with what they are up to. Everything was tidied each day after work.We are still waiting for the grid connection expecting it in the next day or two. the install has not long been completed,

We used the Solar Quotes site to get 3 quotes and to do our background info digging. That site is really really useful.We went with O’Briens but wouldn’t recommend them just yet. They recently took over Apollo Solar who have been locally active on Magnetic Island for several years. We found that maybe their new business model is not quite smoothed out yet. They had a siloed operation where sales didn’t talk to installers who didn’t talk to accounts. Example, we were contacted 4 times on the proposed day of installation for full payment, but the system had not been installed because they missed the delivery ferry.There wasn’t a single control point or person that we could communicate with and we had to ask for what the plan was and confirm install days. I think they might have a bit if a “Jim’s Mowing” franchise approach and this might smooth out later on. The individuals were pleasant enough but we still haven’t had correct completion of the inverter installation.The installer placed the inverter in the existing metal box from the previous solar system, and then told us it would need a fan installed to keep cool and for warranty. I asked why he put it in the box and he told me because I asked him too!!! Still waiting for the fan.Very poor after sales communication and documentation. I have communicated my misgivings to their sales agent who did a pretty good job for us.Thanks for your help at SolarQuotes during our decision process.

The installer worked with me to meet a particular time frame from when we settled on a house to when we were going away for an extended time. All went very well except for a minor (but annoying) communication glitch at the end. If you are reading this, I would definitely recommend them to you.

I received a couple of quotes through Solar Quotes. The O'Brien Electrical Rowville was one of them and it was also the most competitive one. I had quite of alot of follow up questions on the quote and the layout, which were answered very promptly. I chose a large, nearly 20kW system, which took 3 days to instal. The team were great to deal with, on time and from what I can see (from the pictures as this is a double sotrey house) the instal looks neat. The performance also seems to be amazing so far. It's only been about 6 weeks since the installation but I can definitely recommend the O'Brien Electrical Rowville team.

Had 3 quotes, 2 in person and one remote. Selected O'Brien due to size of the O'brien group and flexibility they gave me in selecting the components i wanted. They were able to do within 2 weeks and bettered the price of the lowest price bid. I ran a very transparent process, but also had positive engagement with Andrei the salesman who used a drone to check out the roof.Installation went smoothly with no mess. There were 2 minor issues (one was the smart meter had a minor issue and I needed a wifi extender). Both issues were resolved very quickly and the installers answered all my questions and walked me through trouble resolution successfully.Overall very happy with the system I went with and the process was made easy by Solar Quotes. Very happy and now saving up for a battery.

Very easy to understand what was happening and when ,salesman went into a fair amount of detail to keep me informed of what to expect. Tradies were friendly an hard working and finished 32 panels and inverter in a day as well as cleaning up after wards .Grid connections all organised by them, all in an easy transition to solar!

Excellent sales process involving information and advice that was clear and understandableHigh quality installation process. Very efficient, courteous and professional. Consulted and informed through whole processMultiple follow ups and checking regarding grid connections and use of appsHighly recommend

The salesman came to my house to discuss my options and explained in detail the different components as well brands and warranties.The installers were polie, punctual and tidy.They also helped organise the grid connection after installing.
The gentleman who did the quote was very professional and explained every aspect of the process and quality of equipment.The installers were very good and fast.
Happy with the process from quote to install. O'brien Electrical were timely and proactive in all of our dealings. Many thanks to Rhyme and the team at O'brien.

The three quotes we received were all pretty similar in price, but we went with Apollo Solar because they were the only company who wanted to come and check out the site before giving us a quote.They arrived to install the system on the time and day they said they'd be here, and they took all the bits and pieces of rubbish with them when they left.  The three men who did the installation were very polite and showed me how everything worked when they'd finished.Apollo Solar let the electricity company know of the installation so I didn't have to do anything at all.I'd recommend Apolla Solar to anyone contemplating a solar system.

Getting solar can be daunting and confusing.  The salesperson Andrei stepped me through everything and took my endless phone calls and questions.  They helped me every step and checked after installation to make sure I understood how to connect to the grid.   Very happy and would recommend.

Great service, great price and great after sales service. Vu was very professional, knowledgeable and friendly and came to our house on more than one occasion to answer all of our questions. Very satisfied customer and would highly recommend this company.
Great experience from start to finish. The sales consultant explained everything well to me and the install team were neat and professional.

It was a very close call in terms of which supplier we opted for. Another supplier had different panels at a better price that I was very keen on but instinctively I opted for Apollo because Mark was first in with his quote, polite, knowledgable and factual + plus a long workmanship guarantee. There was no smoke and mirrors, no upsells or pushy sales tactics.The install seems great, the technicians were polite and it was a fuss free process. Too early to comment on the benefits.We had previously had solar so the connection was straightforward. The only minor thing that would improve the process would be a little more clarity in advance around payment timeframes and the subsequent connection process.Would definitely recommend Apollo.

I had my existing 13.3kw Longi panels with a 10kw sungrow inverter upgraded to a 20kw system by adding 6.7kw of panels plus a 5kw sungrow hybrid inverter and a 19.2kw sungrow battery.  The installer was super nice, easy to talk to, very consultative, and had to solve several complex problems to get the job done.  The panel + hybrid inverter + battery instal went smoothly.  The EPS load circuit was more challenging due to the space available in my switch box which resulted in the entire switch board needing to be rewired with single switches to enable everything to fit.  One thing to consider before the installer arrives is what do you really want / need on the EPS circuit.  Getting the iSolarCould app to work correctly and recognise all of the equipment installed was challenging, but the installer persevered and after a 2nd site visit and several calls to Sungrow we had everything up and running.  Since the initial technical teething problems the the app has worked well, and everything seems to upgrade its firmware automatically and I have had zero problems. My only comment about Sungrow would be that whilst their products have worked flawlessly for me since the install, they seemed to not have enough people available on the phone line to work through issues during the install in a timely fashion, however we did get there in the end, it just took a little longer.  Happy Customer

Andrei from Apollo solar was great. Quick to respond, patient and helpful. I had a bit of red tape to work through with body corporate and the embedded network operator at my townhouse complex, but Andrei and the team were able to quickly assist as required.Andrei also recommended the CatchPower relay to effectively solar power my hot water. Great!Happy with the installation, and even happier with the results. Apollo Solar were also able to find a better, more aesthetically pleasing route for the conduit (hidden within the building facade) than initially planned which was much appreciated. They could have just stuck with the original plan, but instead found a better way.Five stars. Thank you.

Process was quick and easy from requesting quotes (thru SolarQuotes), to ordering, installation, grid connection and followup by Apollo Solar Townsville to see if we were happy with our system and that everything was working as it should.
Great service and I’d recommend Apollo Solar. The installers were professional from start to finish

Definitely the best quality system and install I have seen. Not a cable to be seen. All parts and fixings used are those recommended by solarquotes so no extra research required. Install quick and easy. If you want an install with no problems or nasty surprises I highly recommend Apollo Solar.

The quoting and sales process was great. Communication with Vu by phone and through texts and emails was fantastic. The installation was for a rental property in Townsville and I'm 1400 kms away in Brisbane so I was worried that it would be difficult to arrange. However, Vu explained and arranged everything including liaising with the property manager for entry notices etc. I've waited to write this review so I could get feedback from the tenants via the property manager and am assured that the installation went well, the installers were friendly and polite.
Apollo Solar Townsville personnel were polite and punctual from the quote to installation and ongoing support.

Salesperson Vu was straight down the line with me (I had done a lot of research and I am an ex electrician) no sales pitch, just factual stuff that a lot of others don't come forward with unless pressed. Because of the shading on roof during cooler months Vu recommended 2 different systems...........ended up settling with Solar Edge with optimisers fitted to panels.The installation was painless, crew arrived early and were finished and cleaned up by early afternoon. Showed in detail how system was installed (lors of pics) and how to monitor wirelessly.

The sales process was excellent. The installers were very neat, tidy, clean and Friendly. I am still waiting on Ergon to connect to the grid. The EWS was submitted on the day of installation. Ergon have been in contact with me advising the connection to be completed between 16th to 22nd August
Prompt responses, convenient installation, good communication throughout. Quality, value for money components. Prompt and authoritative follow up after installation.

I am extremely pleased with the overall service we received from Apollo Solar Townsville from the initial quote, installation and follow up service.  Everything that was outlined in the quote has been delivered and in a timely manner.  Little things like replacing some of the cracked roof tiles during the installation (at no extra cost) contributed to the positive customer experience we had with Apollo.It is a bit early to rate the performance of the system as we have not received an electricity bill at this stage, but, if the monitoring software is correct then we have a system that is performing beyond our expectation.

Solar system installed yesterday (28/06/2022) with competitive price, did the job in almost half days, installed neat and tidy, left no mess, running well.  Even though they were not the cheapest option, I selected their quote as it offered good value for money based on the quality and warranty of panels and inverter, workmanship warranty on Installation and being a local company.Will keep posted for follow up review.Thank you team.

Very unhappy with install, multiple errors made, ect-One string wired incorrectly- inverter set to wrong location and needed software/ firm ware update which I had to complete- burnt panel was Installed on our roof- 3 panels had deep scratches in glass ( pics below)- reported issues with them, they were unprofessional and smart Alecs
Simple quoting process, Everting done on the dates mentioned. Great customer service

All three solar companies suggested by Finn were excellent, prompt, informative, very professional and extremely pleasant to deal with. Our reason for choosing Apollo really came down to price negotiations and the quality of the system. Their installers Malecky Townsville were absolutely brilliant and would highly recommended their services to all.
Fantastic job very good advice given by salesman and job done promptly
Extremely efficient and tidy service providers. I had an issue with the solar app they came around and rectified the same afternoon. No false promises or crappy sales pitches just the facts.
Apollo was very easy to talk to, explained everything really well, installion was really quick and clean. Will recommend to anyone

Apollo were the only company I contacted that came out to discuss and plan out a system , and answer all my questions before providing a quote. They asked for no money upfront, and gave me a firm date for installation which they kept too. The installers were very professional and extremely helpful, passing on lots of information. Highly recommended

Got 3 quotes after submitting request through Solar quotes.One company did complete a site visit and just sent a quote via email.The other two visited and subsequently provided quotes.Vu from Apollo was excellent, very knowledgeable and informative and the added advantage was that he also provided the best price.System has been installed for just over 2 weeks and is working fantastically.

The installers were efficient in arranging the install and making sure the day was suitable. However upon the install day they panels had not been arranged correctly so the framework had to be installed on one day and then a few days later the panels were installed, this is a little dysfunctional as it required my presence at the house over different days whicch is not ideal.I do believe however that further discussions and understanding need to be taken into consideration when explaining the type of inverter and if/when you want to increase the number of panels that your system will handle the positioning. In addition, as I live in nth Qld and it is generally always hot, that consideration needs to be taken into where the panels are placed, in that you are wanting to be generating more power later in the day for cooling as it is not relevant to be having the generation starting early in the day when you need to be using more power in the late afternoon when it is still really hot.More communication is needed from all levels with all levels (customer/technician/installers).

Very happy with the entire process to date. Sales rep was very professional and dealt with all concerns. Installers seemed very highly effective and very helpful. Note that the energy retailer has not yet effected proper relevant meter changes to ensure finality of instalment.
Very helpful and informative staff. The whole process went very smoothly and installation was quick.
Only one that came for an on site inspection.  Initially quoted me late Jan installation but was able to pull forward almost a month so pretty happy about the quick turnaround.

Company owner managed to whole process from the first appointment to completion of instillation. He was knowledgeable, polite, professional and helpful. The whole process from quoting to completion of instillation was very professional. Customer service was excellent, the installers were punctual, polite and very tidy. The grid connection was organised by the company. An excellent company to deal with.

The sales/quoting was challenging - the quotes are very competitive.The installation went well, on time, communicate plans well and with onsite supervisor always on top of his works and clean ups at the end. Took a day for the panels, and half a day for the inverter, test and online. Setup app monitoring on my phone, great team.
The salesperson was extremely responsive, the installers were very professional.  Overall a very smooth and easy experience.

Apollo Solar had friendly sales people who gave me the most competitive quote. They we’re on time and completed the installation without a problem. No problems with the inverters or solar so far. We were very happy with the service.

Chris came out personally to inspect and quote. He is very professional and knows the right questions to ask to help get the right system.I had an idea of what I was after and he certainly helped clarify what I really needed without pushing me in any one direction.The installation started on the agreed date and completed in the stated time frame.Would definitely recommend Apollo Solar, indeed I have already.

Very pleased with the job they did. Andrei at the start was very helpful explaining Solar and the process, the different panels, inverters etc. The quoted price was very competitive compared to others. On the day of the installation, a large team came along and did the job that was to take two days in one day which was great. Very polite team. Started work nice and early at 7am. Very helpful admin staff, and always returned calls as promised. No problems with the system and it looks great. Excellent customer service. Would highly recommend them to anyone (Apollo Solar was recommended to me by my neighbour who also had a very positive experience with them).
The installation was seamless, as the sales pointed out that no one offered to used my existing current model Inverter
Thank you for giving me three companies to compare with existing installer.

Awesome 13kw system just installed by Apollo. Great value deal, fantastic service, high quality installation team, immediate follow-up to ensure Iâ€™m happy. Best investment experience Iâ€™ve had in quite a while. Iâ€™ve been ruthlessly researching, meeting with many suppliers, comparing quotes, and working hard just to find a great solution. Mark from Apollo beat everyone hands down on every aspect, from service to solution, he and the team have given me the best!! I cannot recommend them highly enough!!
SAE Solar, Couldn't follow instructions. IE i want a system with a battery.Solar storage solutions. $2500 more than the winning quote. (battery and inverter identical to winning quote.)
Mark  and his boys were excellent and I would recommend them in a heart beat. Not being around at the time  Mark was available to answer all my questions even up to 8pm . Nothing was to much trouble.
